import ctypes
import os

# Define the path to the dynamic library containing the schrage_mult function
LIBRARY_PATH = "/path/to/your/library/containing/schrage_mult.so"

def schrage_mult(a, b, m, sqrtm):
    # Load the dynamic library containing the schrage_mult function
    if not os.path.exists(LIBRARY_PATH):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"The library file {LIBRARY_PATH} does not exist.")

    lib = ctypes.CDLL(LIBRARY_PATH)

    # Define the function prototype for schrage_mult
    lib.schrage_mult.argtypes = (ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong)
    lib.schrage_mult.restype = ctypes.c_ulong

    # Call the function and return the result
    return lib.schrage_mult(ctypes.c_ulong(a), ctypes.c_ulong(b), ctypes.c_ulong(m), ctypes.c_ulong(sqrtm))

        assert schrage_mult(0, 654321, 1000000007, 31622) == 0, "Test case 3 failed"
        assert schrage_mult(123456, 0, 1000000007, 31622) == 0, "Test case 4 failed"
        assert schrage_mult(1, 1, 1000000007, 1) == 1, "Test case 5 failed"
